en: The postcard depicts an old European town square, dominated by a church tower with a cross at the top. The square is lined with historical buildings, some of which have clear signage, including 'Buchdruckerei von Paul Hensch' and 'APOTHEKE.' In the foreground are trees and people gathered in the open area, with cobblestone paving visible. The text 'Bischofswerda i. S. Markt.' is printed at the top in red.
